insertText.text: Fictional project, people, and figures throughout

A fictional garden project gives
residents a place to share skills
and explore what they can grow.

Work begins with an open workshop
and a small planting area.

Bring a question.
Try a new skill.
Learn from a neighbor.

Choose a small plot.
Plan what to plant.
Share the harvest.

Meet around a table.
Listen to local stories.
Make space for others.

A fictional annual allowance
for space, materials, and
shared coordination.

A fictional contribution
toward workshops and
seasonal activities.
Illustrative figures only; not Earthkind financial information.

Bring an idea for a shared place
and imagine what comes next.
